Data extraction: HCL block becomes a container KeyValue node

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.tslp.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"data_extraction\":true,\"language\":\"hcl\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("resource \"aws_instance\" \"web\" {\n  ami = \"ami-123\"\n  instance_type = \"t2.micro\"\n}\n", config)
    println(result.data)
    println(result.data?.children)
}
```
